construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation constructed in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.transaction: transaction_id,date(YYYY-MM-DD),amount(positive decimal, max two fraction digits),currency(three uppercase letters),account,card_number(empty or 13-19 digits, spaces/hyphens accepted on input)
shared_schema.formats: JSON array or encoded array; CSV with exact shared transaction field order; ISO 20022-style pain.001.001.09 Document/CstmrCdtTrfInitn/PmtInf with ReqdExctnDt/Dt and CdtTrfTxInf fields PmtId/EndToEndId, Amt/InstdAmt@Ccy, CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN
shared_schema.output: status plus normalized envelope, transactions with masked PANs, faq and documents; error returns status=error and generic message
shared_schema.validation: Single validate(envelope, phase) boundary applied at input, normalized, FAQ and document stages; decimal arithmetic; unique identifiers; valid dates; positive income; explained risk factors

cross_stage_handoffs: Raw format adapter -> shared validated normalized envelope
Knowledge retrieval -> validated FAQ evidence/answer or explicit abstention in the envelope
Document automation consumes that FAQ envelope, propagates support_response unchanged, extracts rows, renders CSV, aggregates by currency and performs screening/risk checks
Final document envelope is validated before serialization

behavior.retrieval: Case-insensitive unique lexical overlap excluding stopwords, at least one matching term; ties broken by knowledge id; answer is exact cited KB text
behavior.abstention: No lexical match or empty KB returns null answer, no citations and an explicit reason, also embedded in the document
behavior.optional_callable: run(payload, answerer=None); injected callable receives question and copied evidence and must return the exact evidence answer; fixtures test acceptance and hallucination rejection
behavior.screening: KYC pending/rejected or any AML flag requires manual review; allowed AML flags are sanctions_match, unusual_activity, pep
behavior.risk: Baseline 0; nonverified KYC +40; each AML flag +30; loan principal over 3x income +25; transaction amount >=10000 in its stated currency +20; capped at 100 with all factor points and reasons shown
behavior.masking: PAN fields expose last four digits only; PAN-like digit runs in textual input values are also masked; generic CLI errors do not echo input; spreadsheet formulas escaped
behavior.fixtures: Explicitly synthetic customer, loan, fake accounts and fake IBANs; test generates 50 randomized transactions with seed 23; example uses fabricated transaction amounts
behavior.determinism: No time-dependent behavior, live inference or external lookups
